title: 《Dying Light》前系列负责人加入 Bloober Team 恐怖品牌 Broken Mirror Games

Former Dying Light franchise lead joins Bloober Team

Former Dying Light franchise lead joins Bloober Team horror imprint Broken Mirror Games
'If you’re a developer, studio, or creator working on something interesting in horror, give me a shout!'
Nicole Carpenter
,
Columnist
,
Game Developer
September 29, 2026
schedule
2 Min Read
Image via Broken Mirror Games
Tymon Smektala, previously Techland's franchise director, is joining Polish studio Bloober Team as its executive director for horror imprint Broken Mirror Games.
"After more than 13 years at Techland, I’m taking on a new challenge: leading the imprint, shaping its creative direction and portfolio, and working with talented external studios to bring new perspectives on horror in gaming,"
Smektala wrote on LinkedIn
. "For starters I’m joining the teams behind the already in-production
Saw: Genesis
and
Onyx: The Dark Grip
to help bring these games to players, while also looking for new projects and creative partnerships that explore the many faces of fear.
Broken Mirror is a 'co-development label' under Bloober Team. Since the subsidiary was announced in 2024, it has released
Star Trek: Infection
and
I Hate This Place
. Bloober Team itself is known for
Blair Witch
,
Layers of Fear
, and its
Silent Hill 2
remake, among games. Bloober Team was founded in 2008. While the studio is best known for its horror games, Bloober, one of its first games, was an ode to composer Frédéric Chopin.
Related:
'This shows the power that comes from employees joining forces:' King signs collective bargaining agreement with union workers
Smektala has worked for
Dying Light
studio Techland for the past 13 years, most recently as the franchise director overseeing the studio's slate of franchises. He was in that position for nearly four years before moving to Bloober Team and Broken Mirror Games. Techland created survival horror game
Dead Island
in 2011 and the
Dying Light
series, which started in 2015 with
Dying Light
. Its latest game, survival horror game
Dying Light: The Beast
, was released in 2025.
The Techland veteran is also looking to hear from developers hoping to make terrifying horror games. "If you’re a developer, studio, or creator working on something interesting in horror, give me a shout!" he concluded. "I’d love to hear what you’re cooking up."
